title: 2001 September 24 ERNE returning-particle reference
physics_scope: Counterstreaming/PAD timing and outer-reflection discrimination; a one-field-line test must account for actual sensor acceptance.

sources.title: Tan et al. (2009), outer reflecting boundary evidence
NASA CDAWeb SOHO ERNE-HED L2 1-minute intensity/count subset

missing_required_inputs: Response-calibrated ERNE pitch-angle distributions and uncertainties for the published 17–22 and 28–54 MeV bands; the archived PH/PHC arrays are not pitch-angle distributions.
Time-dependent magnetic direction and frame/acceptance transform used to reconstruct ERNE pitch angles; SOHO has no onboard magnetic-field measurement for this reconstruction.
Independent event shock/field-line/source history and a qualified return/outer-domain physical realization; do not impose the published fitted mirror estimate as both forcing and validation.
Instrument status-word interpretation, energy-response bounds and error/quality treatment for the fetched L2 interval; blank status cells remain archive fill.
Frozen timing/PAD/shape acceptance criteria and actual production comparison, with no amplitude or boundary fitting introduced by this package.

comparison.acceptance_policy: No fitted model output, synthetic observation, relaxed tolerance, or comparison PASS is supplied. Event-specific criteria must be frozen before a production comparison.

frame_units.flux: (cm^2 s sr MeV)^-1 as archived; multiply by1e4 only when explicitly converting to SI
frame_units.energy: HAPI nominal channel centers in MeV, not substitutes for response boundaries
frame_units.pitch_angle: Published mu_m table records magnitude only; signed model convention not inferred
